name: Amergin
text: Amergin is one of the several forms of the name of the oldest poet of the Irish sagas. MacKillop keeps the form as a variant of the longer spelling. The name belongs to the same hero as the main head of the entry.

attributes.attribute: variant of the name of the poet Amairgen
